name: android-analysis-triage-workflow
description: Evidence-led static and isolated dynamic triage of Android APKs and split APK sets for a user-supplied package name, with an analyst handoff.

interface.shortDescription: Static and isolated dynamic APK triage
interface.longDescription: Provide the Android package name to start APK or split-set analysis. A full triage checks the manifest, code, permissions, libraries, and URLs, then runs the app for five minutes in an Android emulator inside a disposable VM with a verified Tor/Privoxy gateway. Managed-sandbox preflight distinguishes ADB and Docker socket restrictions from VM and emulator failures. The handoff includes image hashes, runtime logs, a hashed file-change inventory, and existing VirusTotal reports for APK and created-file hashes. VirusTotal enrichment requires a connected VirusTotal plugin.
capabilities: Hash created, modified, and deleted files
Look up APK and created-file hashes in VirusTotal
interface.defaultPrompt: Analyze this APK for package PACKAGE_NAME using $android-analysis-triage-workflow.
